summary.text:
Let me evaluate each pair.

V09: Reference PDP walnut variant: header/nav not visible in ref (cropped), breadcrumbs, thumbnails left, main image, right panel with IKEA Family price, BESTÅ, description, $197, 17% off, stars, choose color with 2-row swatches +12, Design it yourself, How to get it, Add to bag, Collect points. Candidate: has header bar, breadcrumbs, thumbnails, main image, right panel same info, choose color with 2 rows of swatches (no +12, shows 14 swatches), missing "Design it yourself" section, missing heart icon, missing Collect points, rating count 867 vs 123, missing "All media/View in 3D" buttons on image. Layout largely matches. Key layout correct with some local differences → 0.75.

V10: Reference bag: BESTÅ first, STUBBARB second, qty controls, order summary right with $260, Afterpay, Visa card, Save $47, Collect 260 points, Apply discount code, Continue to checkout, payment icons. Candidate: STUBBARB first (order swapped), BESTÅ second, qty 2 on STUBBARB, order summary missing Visa Credit Card block, totals match. Delivery summary present. Some differences: item order swapped, missing Visa card promo, missing "Pick up yourself" link, discount amounts differ (save $2.00 vs $4.00 for STUBBARB). Layout largely same → 0.75.

V11: Reference drawer: dimmed backdrop, right drawer "BESTÅ / This product is made up of 6 parts" list with quantities 2/8/4/2/4. Candidate: drawer present with same 6 parts, quantities 1/4/2/1/2/2 (different quantities, since candidate cart quantities differ), part names shorter (no dimensions). Background dimmed. Layout matches, quantities differ but that's data-driven from cart state (candidate has 1 BESTÅ... actually candidate qty 2 BESTÅ in bag but parts qty 1 frame). Differences: missing dimensions text, quantities differ. Structure/layout/spacing match well → 0.75. Maybe 0.75.

V12: Reference reviews modal: 3.7 score left, stars, based on 123, distribution bars, aspect ratings (Appearance 4.3, etc.), Write a review button; right: Filter/Sort by, tabs, Reviews summary with AI badge, Topics chips, review with stars/date/title/body, Dylan name, Report, Helpful, Response from IKEA. Candidate: 3.7, stars, based on 123, bars, Write a review; right: Filter/Sort, tabs, summary (shorter), topics chips, review(s). Missing aspect subscores (分项分数 criteria!) — criteria explicitly lists 分项分数. Candidate lacks the aspect ratings (Appearance/Ease of assembly/etc.). Also review shows star count 2 stars vs reference... reference shows 2-star review "Looks good, functions bad" same title. Candidate missing "Response from IKEA", reviewer name "Anonymous reviewer" vs Dylan. The missing aspect scores is one important part missing → 0.5? Criteria: "评分分布、分项分数、筛选排序、评论内容和双栏弹层". Candidate has 评分分布, 筛选排序, 评论内容, 双栏弹层, but missing 分项分数 entirely. One important section missing → 0.5. Other elements match well. I'd give 0.5. Hmm, ".5=可辨认同页面但有多处明显差异或一个重要部分缺失". Missing 分项分数 = one important part missing → 0.5.
